headline: As of 05:00: every team filed its Tuesday status on time; no blockers changed overnight.
items: All six executive teams and the Chief of Staff filed Tuesday status before cutoff.
The internal CRM technical run stays accepted; product sign-off waits on a founder's hands-on test.
Research stays paused pending a founder decision.
Some specialist team reports were not received; flagged for follow-up.
Thursday status cutoffs move to the morning starting tomorrow, 2026-11-19.
